== Summary ==

Open coursebook surveying the history of Western civilisation: the first civilisations of Mesopotamia, Egypt, and the ancient Near East; ancient Greece and the Hellenistic world; the Roman Republic and the Roman Empire; the Byzantine Empire; the European Middle Ages; the development of Russia; the Renaissance; the Protestant Reformation; and, in chapter 12, the rise of nation-states.

Chapter 12, "The Rise of Nation-States", treats the Peace of Westphalia and the emergence of sovereignty, the Reconquista and the Spanish Habsburgs, Philip II and the Spanish Armada, the Siglo de Oro, Elizabeth I and English patriotism, the early Stuart monarchs and the English Civil War, the Protectorate and the Restoration, the Glorious Revolution, Richelieu and Mazarin in France, Louis XIV and absolutism, the War of the Spanish Succession and the Peace of Utrecht, and Peter the Great's westernisation of Russia.

Each section follows a common scheme of a learning objective, key points, glossary terms, and narrative text. Parts of the content are adapted from Boundless World History under a CC BY-SA licence; the LibreTexts edition was curated by LibreTexts. The text carries no declared publication year on the LibreTexts site (the edition was last updated on 13 October 2022).
